meta.title: Plugin online updates
meta.description: Local-test v0.5.3 is not published to public npm. Public npm remains v0.5.0; local archives require separate installation through the official manager. Final archive and local-install results are recorded in the delivered acceptance report; new-dialog browser checks and live UI acceptance remain pending. Open Plugin online updates in the sidebar, check all updates, select eligible compatible stable releases, then review Update selected. At most 20 targets per batch; initial opening does not query or select updates. Version discovery and replacement admission are separate and source-scoped; a failed or incomplete check does not mean up to date. Wait for current tasks to finish naturally by default. Stopping current Agent activities requires additional consent, clears queued input and cannot undo completed operations. External terminals and independent Workers are never killed; DSH is not automatically closed or restarted. Normal npm updates use the official exact-version Host path, preserve npm identity and verify files and activation. The Host refetches using existing fallback settings; prepared bytes are not an atomic exact-byte installation guarantee. Only identified, byte-verified older ordinary Doctor archives can migrate back to npm at the same version after independent confirmation. Self, WSL, arbitrary local, Git and linked installations are not automatically migrated. JS dependencies are limited to reviewed unchanged declarations and verified installed graphs and files without native dependencies or install lifecycle scripts. Fixed public-mirror paths require canonical archive comparison and additional consent without silently changing registry configuration. WSL candidates are checked against canonical public archives and the modern declaration contract instead of a fixed version allowlist. Production 0.26.2 to 0.29.0 updates and preprepared old-package restoration passed in an owned isolated Host. Schema4 retains all original-archive proofs; unknown install/reapply/recovery outcomes are not resent and retained generations are never silently deleted; old resources remain, the source remains a local archive, and existing sessions may retain old presets. The detail-page extension is a separate read-only Doctor check and navigation entry, not built-in Versions or an installer. Self-update is confirmed separately under its npm, fixed public-mirror or fixed full-commit GitHub policy; GitHub main HEAD is not a signed Release. Target failure and recovery are recorded separately; unknown outcomes are not resent. Stock Union Search npm/HMR remains unsafe for hot updates. v0.5.1 only blocked that risk, which is not a fix. v0.5.2 adds the reviewed 0.10.24 to 0.10.25 complete-dependency local generation route: original JavaScript and dependency bytes remain unchanged, target and distinct fresh recovery archives are prepared before replacement, and actual Loader generation identity is verified for enabled plugins. The installation becomes a Doctor-owned local archive, not npm; built-in Versions eligibility is not preserved and extra source acknowledgement is required. Unreviewed versions, unknown outcomes and unverifiable current generations remain blocked; retained-generation exhaustion refuses before mutation without silently deleting old resources. Installing the updater does not automatically update Union or WSL. No DSH, Node or Electron patching, debugger injection, forced cache clearing, process termination, unlocking, elevation, script approval or version exemptions. Local diagnostics are not uploaded. Windows x64 only; real-plugin upgrade and browser acceptance remain pending.
